test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Electrician) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the maximum allowable distance of the screw from the end point of a joint during installation of PVC channel?
solution:
During installation of a PVC channel, the screw must be placed close enough to the joint end to ensure proper mechanical strength and alignment.

Standards and common installation practices specify that the maximum allowable distance of the screw from the end point of a joint is** 15 cm.**

**Explanation:**

__
 
• The joint is the most critical area because two separate PVC pieces are connected. If the screw is placed too far from the joint, the joint area remains unsupported.
 
• This can cause: Opening of the joint, Sagging of the channel, or misalignment over time due to vibration or load.

 ​__
